subtitle: 因家中急事缺了實驗課，寫信說明並申請補做
task: You missed yesterday's chemistry lab because of a family emergency. Write an email to your lab instructor, Dr. Hughes, explaining what happened and asking whether you can make up the lab.
taskZh: 你因為家裡有急事，錯過了昨天的化學實驗課。寫一封 email 給實驗課老師 Hughes 博士，說明發生了什麼事，並詢問能否補做實驗。
focus: 正式語氣：先自我介紹，再說明來信目的
誠實說明原因，並為沒有事先通知道歉

en: My name is Alex Chen, and I am in your Tuesday afternoon section of CHEM 101. I am writing to explain why I missed yesterday's lab on acid-base titration and to ask whether I could make it up.

On Monday night, I received a call from my family in Taiwan. My grandfather had been taken to the hospital, and I spent most of the night on the phone with my parents. By the time the situation was stable, I was too exhausted to work safely with chemicals, so I decided it was better not to attend. I should have emailed you before the lab, and I apologize for not doing so.

If possible, I would like to join another section this week or complete the experiment during open lab hours. I have already read the procedure and am happy to submit the report by the original deadline.
Thank you very much for considering my request.
zh: 我是 Alex Chen，修您星期二下午那一班的 CHEM 101。來信是想說明我為什麼缺席昨天的酸鹼滴定實驗，並詢問是否能補做。
星期一晚上，我接到台灣家人的電話。我祖父被送進醫院，我大半夜都在和父母通電話。等到情況穩定時，我已經累到無法安全地操作化學藥品，所以決定不去上課比較好。我應該在實驗課前先寫信通知您，對此我深感抱歉。
如果可以的話，我希望這週能加入其他班，或在實驗室開放時間完成實驗。我已經讀過實驗步驟，也願意在原本的期限前繳交報告。
非常感謝您考慮我的請求。
